applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard area near Valley View Road
findings.comment: Proposed trees are positioned 0-1.5 feet from overhead electric (OHE) distribution line on southern boundary. Utility-compatibility status of specific tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) cannot be conclusively determined from submitted plans to verify whether species are marked as utility-compatible in ECM Appendix F. ECM Appendix F UC column designation not provided.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard area near Valley View Road
findings.comment: Large trees with mature height 40+ feet (Cedar Elm and Live Oak per ECM Appendix F) are proposed at 0-1.5 feet from overhead electric distribution conductor. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 25 lateral feet clearance. Measured distances: 0 feet (westernmost), 1.5 feet (central), 0 feet (easternmost).

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near utility poles
findings.comment: Proposed tree measured at 8.5 lateral feet from overhead electric utility pole. UCM § 1.10.10.4 prohibits trees within 10 lateral feet of poles. Tree location is 1.5 feet closer than minimum required distance.

applicableAreas: Central parking area - landscape island adjacent to electrical transformer pad
findings.comment: Proposed tree measured at 1.7 lateral feet from pad-mounted electrical transformer equipment. UCM § 1.10.10.4 requires minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from pad-mounted equipment or between equipment access door and drivable surface. Tree position violates distance requirement by 8.3 feet.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - entire OHE line; central parking area - transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Trees are shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities (OHE line depicted on Sheet 31; transformer pad locations identifiable). However, NO dimension lines, clearance distances, or measurement references are provided on the landscape plan. Clearances cannot be verified from the plan drawings; applicant must add dimension lines and clearance notations from tree trunk centers to outside conductors (for overhead lines) and equipment locations.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary - street yard trees near OHE line; central parking area - tree near transformer pad
findings.comment: Plans propose trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) within prohibited clearance zones: trees within 15-25 feet of overhead distribution conductors and within 10 feet of utility poles and transformer equipment. No documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing these variations is provided or referenced on the plans, in the site plan notes, or in the submitted documents.
